decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 08 September 2019 Time 13:26 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 47), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) has been changed for one of a different specification under Parc Ferme and a 3rd Control Electronics (CE) have been used.
offence: Breach of Articles 34.6 and 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed power unit element is of a different specification from the one used during qualifying, the parts were replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per Article 34.2. As the ICE is a different specification and was changed whilst the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
